candidates.change_summary: Replace the return value of onERC721Received with a different bytes4 constant, e.g. bytes4(0xdeadbeef).
Replace the return value with bytes4(0).
Return a keccak256 hash of a different string, e.g. keccak256("NotTheRightSelector").
Return a constant bytes4 derived from the first argument (msg.sender), e.g. bytes4(uint32(uint160(address))), which changes behavior per call.
Delete the assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' so baseToken remains its default value (address(0)).
Replace 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = address(0);' so baseToken is always set to zero address regardless of the input parameter.
Delete the assignment 'nft = _nft;' so the nft state variable remains address(0) after initialize.
Replace 'nft = _nft;' with 'nft = address(0);' so initialize always sets nft to the zero address.
Replace 'nft = _nft;' with 'nft = _baseToken;' so nft is set to the base token address instead of the intended NFT address.
Replace 'changeFee = _changeFee;' with 'changeFee = 0;' so that the stored changeFee is always zero instead of the provided argument.
Replace 'changeFee = _changeFee;' with 'changeFee = _changeFee + 1;' so that the stored fee is incremented by one from the supplied value.
Delete the assignment 'changeFee = _changeFee;' so that changeFee retains its default zero value.
Replace 'feeRate = _feeRate;' with 'feeRate = _feeRate + 1;' so that the stored fee rate always differs by 1 from the input.
Replace 'feeRate = _feeRate;' with 'feeRate = 0;' so that the stored fee rate is always zero regardless of input.
Delete the statement 'feeRate = _feeRate;' so that feeRate remains its default value (0) after initialization.
Replace 'feeRate = _feeRate;' with 'feeRate = uint16(_feeRate % 100);' so that the stored fee rate is the input modulo 100.
Delete the assignment `initialized = true;` so the contract remains uninitialized after initialize completes.
Replace `initialized = true;` with `initialized = false;` so the contract stays permanently uninitialized.
Insert an unconditional revert right before `initialized = true;` so the function never sets the flag.
Move `initialized = true;` to before the `if (initialized) revert ...` check, causing every call to revert and never set the flag.
Replace the guard `if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();` with `require(!initialized)` and change the assignment to `initialized = false`.
